integrity: Analytical proof, complete combinatorial parameterization and exact-rational standalone checker; unrelated earlier results not recertified.
scientific_limitations: Claims concern instantaneous target-strain growth at admissible states; no assertion of long-run invasion or equilibrium.
Pairwise co-exposure marginals, not solely individual seroprevalences, are fixed.
States need not be reachable from an initially naive population.
Historical priority is literature-bounded; no independent audit.
title: Four-strain pairwise immune-history aliasing with opposite initial infection growth
